title: [Quality Management] Enforce rules and restrictions with indirect and implicit permissions
summary: Quality Management now uses InherentPermissions to enforce rules when inspections are automatically created, requiring users to hold the new QltyMgmt - I. Create permission set if generation rules are triggered, preventing silent failures.
key_points: InherentPermissions added to Quality Inspection Setup and Generation Rule tables to control access
New QltyMgmt - I. Create permission set grants indirect permissions for inspection creation
Users without QM permissions get standard permission errors instead of silent skips when generation rules trigger
Automatic inspection creation checks setup and rules before requiring permissions
Create Quality Inspection actions use AccessByPermission to hide views from users with only creation permissions
quote: Implement InherentPermissions so users without QM permissions would not silently skip mandatory Quality Inspection creation or transaction restrictions.
